conclusion: The fixed-target inventory trial resumed from 6 consumed turns and reached COMPLETE at 11 without repeating Planner. Four real Reviewer calls produced a canonical plan and Markdown. This proves recovery/export on that captured case, not full-repository accuracy. A source audit still found a missed successful-test fixture update, so Reviewer approval is not reliable sign-off.

control_gate.note: A declared control suite must accept the reasonable proposal and reject both planted defects. Missing, truncated, duplicate or incorrect decisions fail the gate. This is a research qualification check, not a general accuracy score or automatic runtime model switch. Invalid/missing decisions are not counted as correct; the 6144 run did not attempt the nil-type control. No tested configuration passed the complete suite. Passing the decision checks would still not prove correct justifications or general accuracy.
